detection.rule_text:
title: Encoded PowerShell Command Line
id: win-encoded-powershell
status: test
description: Detects PowerShell started with an encoded command (fixture rule for blue tests).
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -EncodedCommand '
  condition: selection_img and selection_cli
level: medium
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
detection.logic_summary: PowerShell or pwsh process whose command line contains -enc or -EncodedCommand.

false_positives.label_note: Sanctioned daily asset inventory task (IT ticket INV-114).

prior_blue_edits.failure_reason: Relied on an attacker-controllable field only; trivially evadable.

_why_invalid: must_detect is empty, rule_format is not sigma, max_edits above the ceiling of 5.
